title: Apply Discount Every n Orders
statement: Cashier class: every nth customer gets discount% off the subtotal; getBill(product, amount) returns the bill; answers within 1e-5 accepted.
constraints: getBill: 1 <= product.length <= products.length, unique ids present in products, 1 <= amount[j] <= 1000

examples.input: n=3, discount=50 (official example: 3rd bill 1600 becomes 800, 6th bill 14700 becomes 7350)

visualizationCap: orders capped at 50 calls; the solution is O(P) setup and O(|product|) per call
notes: Constraints came from a search summary of the official page. The full official example input was not captured; the visualization examples are custom and verified only against the Python solution.
